'''Stéphan Fauve''' (born 20 December 1955 in Paris) is a [[:Category:French physicists|French physicist]]. He is a professor at the [[École normale supérieure (Paris)|École normale supérieure]] (ENS) in [[Paris]], a member of the ENS Physics Laboratory.

== Biography ==
Stéphan Fauve, is a graduate of the [[École normale supérieure de Saint-Cloud]] (1976–1980), agrégé de sciences physiques (1979) and docteur ès sciences (1984).

After defending his thesis in 1984 under the direction of [[Albert Libchaber]] as a preparatory associate at the École normale supérieure, Stephan Fauve was successively Professor at the [[École normale supérieure de Lyon]] (1987–1997), then at the ENS in Paris since 1997.<ref>{{cite web|title=École normale Supérieure de Paris|url=http://archives.diffusion.ens.fr/index.php?res=cycles&idcycle=467|date=}}</ref> He is a member of the [[French Academy of Sciences]], Physics section.

== Scientific work ==
Stéphan Fauve's work has focused mainly on non-linear physics. His thesis work focused on the study of various scenarios of transition to chaos, in particular the measurement of [[critical exponent]]s associated with the cascade of period doubling.<ref>A. Libchaber, C. Laroche and S. Fauve, « Period doubling cascade in mercury, a quantitative measurement », ''J. Physique Lettres'', 43, (1982), <abbr>p.</abbr> 211</ref>  He then carried out the first experiment to highlight the phenomenon of [[stochastic resonance]].<ref>S. Fauve and F. Heslot, « Stochastic resonance in a bistable system », ''Physics Letters'', 97a, (1983), <abbr>p.</abbr> 5</ref> He was one of the founders of the physics laboratory of ENS-Lyon, initiating there the study of various research fields, such as dissipative structures generated by instability,<ref>O. Thual and S. Fauve, « Localized structures generated by subcritical instabilities », ''J.  Physique'', 49, (1988), <abbr>p.</abbr> 1829</ref> granular media,<ref>S. Douady, S. Fauve and C. Laroche, « Subharmonic instabilities and defects in a granular  layer under vertical vibrations », ''Europhysics Letters'', 8, (1989), <abbr>p.</abbr> 621</ref><ref>C. Coste, E. Falcon and S. Fauve, « Solitary waves in a chain of beads in Hertzian contact », ''Phys. Rev.'', e 56, (1997), <abbr>p.</abbr> 6104-6116</ref> sound propagation in complex media (effect of liquid-vapour transition on sound velocity and absorption in two-phase media),<ref>C. Coste, C. Laroche and S. Fauve, « Acoustic resonances in a liquid with vapor bubbles : effect of liquid-vapor transition on sound velocity and attenuation », ''Phys. Rev. Lett.'', 69, (1992), <abbr>p.</abbr> 765-768</ref> sound-vorticity interaction and its application to the detection of intermittent vortex structures in turbulence,<ref>B. Dernoncourt, J.-F. Pinton and S. Fauve, « Experimental study of vorticity filaments in a turbulent swirling flow », ''Physica'', d 117, (1998), <abbr>p.</abbr> 181-190</ref> the study of [[surface wave]]s, which led to the first observation of a hydrodynamic [[Quasicrystal|quasi-crystalline]] pattern <ref>W. S. Edwards and S. Fauve, « Structure quasicristalline engendrée par instabilité paramètrique », ''C. R. Acad. Sci. Paris'', 315-ii, (1992), <abbr>p.</abbr> 417-420</ref><ref>W. S. Edwards and S. Fauve, « Patterns and quasi-patterns in the Faraday experiment », ''J. Fluid Mech.'', 278, (1994), <abbr>p.</abbr> 123</ref> and [[wave turbulence]].<ref>E. Falcon, C. Laroche and S. Fauve, « Observation of gravity-capillary wave turbulence », ''Phys. Rev. Lett.'', 98, (2007), <abbr>p.</abbr> 094503</ref><ref>E. Falcon, S. Aumaître, C. Falcon, C. Laroche and S. Fauve, « Fluctuations of energy flux in wave turbulence », ''Phys. Rev. Lett.'', 100, (2008), <abbr>p.</abbr> 064503</ref> He initiated the VKS (von Karman Sodium) collaboration by proposing an experiment on the dynamo effect that led to the first laboratory observation of  [[magnetic field]] reversal,<ref>S. Aumaître, S. Fauve, S. McNamara and P. Poggi, « Power injected in dissipative systems and the fluctuation theorem », ''Eur. Phys. J.'', b 19, (2001), <abbr>p.</abbr> 449-460</ref><ref>Molten Metal Magnet, January 30, 2007, Phys. Rev. Focus 19, 3; Earth magnetic field reversals mimicked in the lab, Nature News, 9 March 2007, doi:10.1038/news070305-14</ref> with many similarities to the reversals of the Earth's magnetic field.<ref>F. Pétrélis, S. Fauve, E. Dormy and J. P. Valet, « A simple mechanism for the reversals of Earth's magnetic field », ''Phys. Rev. Lett.'', 102, (2009), <abbr>p.</abbr> 144503</ref> He is currently interested in the statistical properties of large scales in turbulence<ref>V. Dallas, S. Fauve and A. Alexakis, « Statistical equilibria of large scales in dissipative hydrodynamic turbulence », ''Phys. Rev. Lett.'', 115, (2015), <abbr>p.</abbr> 204501</ref><ref>V. Shukla, S. Fauve and M. Brachet, « Statistical theory of reversals in two-dimensional confined turbulent flows », ''Phys. Rev.'', e 94, (2016), <abbr>p.</abbr> 061101</ref><ref>G. Michel, F. Pétrélis and S. Fauve, « Observation of thermal equilibrium in capillary wave turbulence », ''Phys. Rev. Lett.'', 118, (2017), <abbr>p.</abbr> 144502</ref> and in modelling the quasi-biennial oscillation laboratory, i. e. the quasi-periodic wind reversals in the equatorial stratosphere.<ref>B. Semin, F. Pétrélis and S. Fauve, « Nonlinear saturation of the large scale flow in a laboratory model of the quasi-biennial oscillation », ''Phys. Rev. Lett.'', 121, (2018), <abbr>p.</abbr> 134502</ref>

== Distinctions ==
* Professor at the Institut Universitaire de France (junior) (1992–1997)
* [[IBM]] Physics Award (1993)
* "Batchelor lecturer" (Cambridge University (2004)
* [[Three Physicists Prize]] (2008)
* Lewis Fry Richardson Medal from the [[European Geosciences Union]] (2009)
* Silver medal from the [[Centre national de la recherche scientifique|CNRS]] (2009)<ref>{{cite web|title=Médaille d'argent du CNRS|url=https://www.cnrs.fr/fr/personne/stephan-fauve|date=January 2009}}</ref>
* CEA Prize, [[French Academy of Sciences]] (2009)
* Professor at the [[Institut Universitaire de France]] (senior) (2009)<ref>{{cite web|title=Institut Universitaire de France|url=http://www.iufrance.fr/les-membres-de-liuf/membre/1341-stephan-fauve.html|date=}}</ref>
* Member of the French Academy of Sciences (2011)<ref>{{cite web|title=Académie des sciences|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-F/stephan-fauve.html|date=}}</ref>
* Member of the [[Academia Europaea]] (2011)
